'''Smythe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], where he dispensed gear to [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and other agents of the Empire.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corporal Smythe first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as the PvP Ranked Enhancements vendor aboard Vaiken Spacedock.<ref name="TOR" /> He was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
